question: Summarize core knowledge for DIS-008 using registered Wiki evidence.

stage_1_draft.answer: According to the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH), Porcine Epidemic Diarrhea (PED) is a non-zoonotic viral disease of pigs caused by a coronavirus, characterized by watery diarrhoea and weight loss. It affects pigs of all ages but is most severe in neonatal piglets, where morbidity and mortality can reach up to 100%, with mortality decreasing as age increases. Transmission occurs primarily via the faecal–oral route, and prevention and control rely on strict biosecurity measures and early detection. Clinically, PED resembles other forms of porcine gastroenteritis, and there is no specific treatment available.

stage_2_grounded.answer: 猪流行性腹泻（Porcine Epidemic Diarrhea，PED）是由冠状病毒引起的非人畜共患病毒性疾病，其特征为水样腹泻和体重下降。[source=A1-WOAH-PED rule=RC-CITATION-001 fact=DIS008-WEB-001-woah-nonzoonotic-coronavirus page=wiki/diseases/DIS-008-porcine-epidemic-diarrhea-virus.md] 该病可感染各年龄段猪只，但在新生仔猪中最为严重，发病率和死亡率可达100%，且随年龄增长死亡率降低。[source=A1-WOAH-PED rule=RC-CITATION-001 fact=DIS008-WEB-002-woah-age-morbidity-mortality page=wiki/diseases/DIS-008-porcine-epidemic-diarrhea-virus.md] 主要传播途径为粪口途径，防控依赖于严格的生物安全措施和早期检测。[source=A1-WOAH-PED rule=RC-CITATION-001 fact=DIS008-WEB-003-woah-fecal-oral-biosecurity-early-detection page=wiki/diseases/DIS-008-porcine-epidemic-diarrhea-virus.md] 临床上与猪其他类型胃肠炎相似，目前无特效治疗方法。[source=A1-WOAH-PED rule=RC-CITATION-001 fact=DIS008-WEB-004-woah-clinical-similarity-no-specific-treatment page=wiki/diseases/DIS-008-porcine-epidemic-diarrhea-virus.md]

question: Explain the diagnosis-support points and limits for DIS-015 using registered Wiki evidence.

stage_1_draft.answer: 根据已注册Wiki证据，猪乙型脑炎（DIS-015）在诊断支持信息中可明确其分类为“病毒病/繁殖障碍”，该信息来源于《猪病学》等权威资料。此外，相关教材章节起始页码为第554页，可作为进一步查阅和参考的依据。上述两点构成了目前可用于诊断支持的边界信息。
